from: 2. A credit of $200 with $50 refunded and $80 applied to an invoice
to: 2. One credit that has had part of it refunded AND part of it applied to an invoice - for example a $200 credit with $50 refunded and $80 applied. To make one: click "Customers" in the top menu, open a customer that has an unpaid invoice worth less than the credit and no deposit on the account, click the "Invoices" tab, click "Issue Credit", type the amount, choose "Issue Store Credit", type a short note and confirm. Then tick the credit's row and the invoice's row together, click "New Payment", leave the invoice's "Payment" box at its full balance, choose any "Payment method" if "Make payment" is greyed out, and click "Make payment". Finally, on the credit's row, in the "Action" column, click the icon whose tooltip reads "Cash Out", type a figure smaller than the amount still open, choose a "Payment method", and click "Cash Out".
